historical_evidence_status: Already examined retrospective diagnostics; never treated as a genuinely untouched final test

candidate_selection.audit_usage: Assess the development-selected candidate; do not use audit to choose another winner
candidate_selection.eligible_sources: Model-only or nominal-opening diagnostics; closing-anchored oracle variants are ineligible
candidate_selection.change_scope: One factor at a time; no unvalidated combination of winning settings

forward_trial_prerequisites: Freeze candidate version, parameters, target markets, primary metric and comparison cohort before its first forecast
Use only data and odds with demonstrable availability at forecast time
Archive candidate and production baseline together before kickoff
Keep production settings unchanged during the trial

promotion_review_gates.primary_result: Positive paired log-loss gain with a predeclared 95% uncertainty interval whose lower bound exceeds zero; account for fixture/gameweek dependence and multiple tested candidates
promotion_review_gates.secondary_results: No aggregate Brier deterioration; inspect calibration and league/market coverage, including high-confidence groups
promotion_review_gates.data_integrity: No unexplained missing-data, source, timing or execution differences between candidate and baseline
promotion_review_gates.approval: Human review and explicit versioned production change; never automatic

betting_edge_claim_requirements: Actual accepted prices and stakes, rejected bets and applicable costs
Comparable timestamped sharp and execution-book closing quotes with documented margin removal
Net realized returns and exposure/drawdown evidence over a sufficient prospective sample
Positive closing-line value alone is supporting evidence, not proof of profitability
four_week_review: Initial evidence and coverage review only; passing a calendar date never satisfies sample-size or promotion gates
future_status: The new parameter/total-anchor candidates currently exist only in this offline benchmark. Forward candidate generation, true closing collection and execution recording require a later explicit implementation.
